answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each identity to a vine of verifiable work history: new agents start with a willow-thin trust budget and earn standing only through small, attested tasks before they may handle valuable trades. Every deal leaves a pulse of signed receipts on a shared ledger, so a fresh fake identity has no history to borrow. An attacker must therefore fund and sustain thousands of fake histories, each costing real completed work and escrowed stake, until forgery costs more than any single fake identity could ever extract.
